headline: Next Mediaworks files financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
summary: Next Mediaworks Limited has submitted its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. These filings provide registered data regarding the company's financial performance during the period. Retail investors holding shares in Next Mediaworks can review the submitted results to assess revenue and profitability trends. The filing offers standard corporate disclosures required for listed entities.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data updates shareholders on the company's financial health.

headline: Next Mediaworks CEO Rohit Kalra resigns effective October 31, 2026
summary: Next Mediaworks Limited has notified the stock exchange that its Chief Executive Officer, Rohit Kalra, will step down from his role. The resignation is scheduled to take effect on October 31, 2026. No details regarding a successor or the reason for his departure were provided in the filing. Retail investors in micro-cap media companies should note executive departures as they can signal strategic shifts or operational instability.
whats_next: Appointment of a new CEO or interim leadership
why_it_matters: Management departures in micro-caps can trigger short-term volatility.
